description: Fixed, format-specific scale factors applied to the absolute thickness biomarkers (the four pachymetry biomarkers of group A and all group B biomarkers); group C is not scaled (Section 2.6). The factors were derived from a comparison of raw mask thicknesses with the ANTERION outputs (Section 2.7): narrow format from 14 persons, wide format from 27 eyes of the device-agreement sample.
availability: The numerical values of the two factors are not distributed with this repository and are available from the authors on request. Enter them under "factors" before running measurement/build_feature_table.py or classification/sensitivity_bowman.py.
format_rule: wide if the exported DICOM has >= 1500 columns, otherwise narrow (Table S1)
